cases.explain: «Божьи пророки» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build God’s house which is at Jerusalem; and with them were the prophets of God, helping them.

cases.sentence: Но око их Бога было над старейшинами иудеев, и их не останавливали, пока донесение не достигло Дария и от него не пришел ___.
cases.explain: «письменный ответ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease, until the matter should come to Darius, and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it.

cases.sentence: Народ строит его из ___ и вкладывает в стены деревянные балки.
cases.explain: «больших камней» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is built with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands.

cases.sentence: Народ строит его из больших камней и вкладывает в стены ___.
cases.explain: «деревянные балки» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is built with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands.

cases.sentence: Но в ___ своего правления Кир, царь Вавилона , повелел отстроить этот дом Божий.
cases.explain: «первый год» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God.

cases.sentence: Он даже вынес из ___ золотые и серебряные вещи Божьего дома, которые Навуходоносор забрал из храма в Иерусалиме и принес в храм в Вавилоне.
cases.explain: «вавилонского храма» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought into the temple of Babylon, those Cyrus the king also took out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

cases.sentence: Он даже вынес из вавилонского храма золотые и серебряные вещи ___, которые Навуходоносор забрал из храма в Иерусалиме и принес в храм в Вавилоне.
cases.explain: «Божьего дома» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought into the temple of Babylon, those Cyrus the king also took out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

cases.sentence: Тогда Шешбацар пришел и заложил основания ___ в Иерусалиме.
cases.explain: «Божьего дома» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then the same Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of God’s house which is in Jerusalem. Since that time even until now it has been being built, and yet it is not completed.

cases.sentence: Итак, если это угодно царю, пусть поищут в ___, что в Вавилоне: правда ли царь Кир повелел отстроить этот дом Божий в Иерусалиме.
cases.explain: «царских архивах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Now therefore, if it seems good to the king, let a search be made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it is so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem; and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.”
